aiSummary.text: Oxford offers lower tuition (£25-35K vs A$38-48K) and significantly faster visa processing (3-4 weeks vs 4-8 weeks). However, Melbourne provides more than double the work hours during study (48 vs 20 hrs/week) and a more generous scholarship structure with fee waivers up to 25%. For students prioritizing post-study work opportunities and work-life balance, Melbourne has a clear edge. For academic prestige and European career access, Oxford is the stronger choice.

about.heroTitle: Empowering Asian Students to Study Abroad
about.heroSubtitle: We guide students from Southeast Asia to the world's best universities — with expert consulting, personalised pathways, and end-to-end support.
about.storyBody1: Saturday Education was founded in 2026 by a team of internationally educated advisors who saw a clear gap — students in Southeast Asia lacked access to honest, expert guidance for studying abroad.
about.storyBody2: We launched in Bangkok with a small cohort of students and a simple promise: real advice from people who have been there. Today, our growing team of alumni advisors from Oxford, Melbourne, and Harvard is expanding across Myanmar, Thailand, and beyond.
about.valuesSubtitle: Every decision we make comes back to these four principles.
about.value1Desc: Every recommendation we make is filtered through one question: is this truly the best path for this student?
about.value2Desc: No hidden fees, no preferred-university kickbacks. We tell students exactly what to expect at every step.
about.value3Desc: Our advisors are alumni of the universities they recommend. Real experience, not brochure knowledge.
about.value4Desc: Our relationship does not end at enrollment. We stay connected through graduation and beyond.
about.teamSubtitle: Our team of international alumni brings first-hand knowledge from the world's top universities.
about.team1Bio: Oxford alumnus (MSc Computer Science). Led 500+ students to UK universities. Based in Yangon.
about.team2Bio: University of Melbourne graduate. Specialist in Australian and UK pathways for Thai students.
about.team3Bio: Harvard Kennedy School. Helped students secure over M in scholarships across 6 years.
about.whySubtitle: Here is what sets us apart from every other consulting firm.
about.why1Desc: Our team studied at the universities we recommend. Our advice comes from lived experience, not brochures or sales scripts.
about.why2Desc: We build a personalised roadmap for every student — the right universities, the right programs, the right fit for your profile and budget.
about.why3Desc: From your first consultation through visa approval and pre-departure prep, we stay by your side at every stage of the journey.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to Begin Your International Journey?
about.ctaSubtitle: Book a free 30-minute consultation with one of our advisors. No obligations, just honest guidance.
